Callout.Name: Drive-By Shooting
Callout.Message: Drive-by shooting reported from a moving vehicle.
Callout.Advisory: Vehicle left, one person injured on the pavement.

Script.Line: It came past, there were shots, and then it was gone.
I did not see the plate. Nobody saw the plate.
There is a boy on the pavement. Somebody needs to help him.

Lines.Approach: Car has gone, one injured on the pavement. Ambulance is rolling with you.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
